Merges now HUMAN-approved: ralph-approved label on the PR, or ralph-auto pre-tagged on the issue = batch approval (Adrian: approve in bulk, no click-per-PR); ralph-gate also runs ONE label-guarded self-heal per PR (fixes reviewer-named defects/red gate in-job — the exact #114 failure class) and Discord-alerts when it's spent.
